patterns: I want to see my salary slip
responses: Salaries are credited on the last working day of the month. You can download your payslips under the 'Payroll' tab on the dashboard.
Please navigate to the 'My Pay' section to view and download your latest payslips.

patterns: How do I apply for leave?
Where is the leave request button?
I want to take a day off
responses: To apply for leave, click on the 'Time Off' widget on your dashboard and select 'New Request' Please refer the link : https://www.greythr.com/.
You can apply for Sick or Casual leave via the 'Leave Management' section in the main menu Please refer the link : https://www.greythr.com/.

patterns: How many leaves do I have left?
Do I have any sick days remaining?
responses: Your current leave balance is displayed on the top right corner of your dashboard homepage.
Please check the 'Leave Balance' card on the dashboard for real-time updates on your remaining days.
You can reset your password by clicking 'Profile Settings' -> 'Security' -> 'Change Password'.
If you are locked out, please use the 'Forgot Password' link on the main login screen.

patterns: What is my health insurance policy?
responses: You can view your active insurance plans and benefits under the 'My Benefits' tab.
Details regarding your health and medical insurance are available in the 'Policy Documents' section.

patterns: I need to talk to a human
responses: You can reach the HR team at hr-support@company.com.
For sensitive matters, please schedule a one-on-one with your HR.
